answer: The reveal must open the same echo hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the wander gate. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. Copying becomes a race the attacker always loses, and producing 26 original texts is the only way to fill 54 aliases; the garden log preserves both halves. That is 37 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
